unfair_advantage: CRISPR Therapeutics AG's proprietary CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing platform, which enables precise and efficient editing of genes in living cells.
milestone_1: First human clinical trial for its lead product, CTX001, in beta-thalassemia and sickle cell disease.
milestone_2: Completion of a Phase 1/2 clinical trial for its lead product, CTX001, in beta-thalassemia and sickle cell disease.
milestone_3: FDA approval for its lead product, CTX001, in beta-thalassemia and sickle cell disease.
kill_risk: High burn rate and lack of near-term revenue streams.
thesis_summary: CRISPR Therapeutics AG has a promising CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing platform, but its high burn rate and lack of near-term revenue streams make it a speculative investment.
thesis_breaks_if: The company achieves significant revenue growth within the next 2-3 years, or its burn rate is reduced through cost-cutting measures.
ten_k_highlights: The company's revenue has been rising at a rate of 5507.9% over the past 5 years.
The company's gross margin has been insufficient, and its return on invested capital (ROIC) has been falling at a rate of 321.3% over the past 5 years.
The company's share count has been rising at a rate of 24.6% over the past 5 years, with dilution being high.
valuation_note: FCF yield -9.2%, PEG -0.2, P/S 1134 — very richly valued — starter position only.
